# Pack: docsite

Documentation sites, read from the records cache the static-docs downloader writes.

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | `context` |
| Version | `0.2.0` |
| Needs a credential to publish | no |

## In which bundles

- Default in: [`cern-team`](../bundles/cern-team.md), [`cluster-manager`](../bundles/cluster-manager.md)
- Optional in: none

Add it to an instance with `archi add docsite`.
